purpose: Stage 3 of a video triage pipeline that uses an LLM (Gemini) to extract qualitative commentary chunks from badminton match transcripts. It windows transcripts into overlapping segments, sends each window to the LLM for filtering, aggregates the results into JSON sidecars, and applies a three-part decision rule to determine which videos to keep based on chunk density.

public_api.name: TriageError
public_api.role: Exception raised when an LLM triage call fails after exhausting all retry attempts, allowing the caller to move that video to a retry list.

public_api.name: load_transcript
public_api.role: Loads a transcript JSON sidecar from the transcripts directory for a given video ID, returning the parsed transcript or None if no file exists.

public_api.name: chunk_windows
public_api.role: Splits transcript segments into overlapping time windows of CHUNK_WINDOW_S seconds with CHUNK_OVERLAP_S overlap, so segments at boundaries appear in multiple windows.

public_api.name: build_triage_prompt
public_api.role: Constructs a (system_prompt, user_prompt) tuple for the LLM, instructing it to filter commentary for qualitative assessments and format the reply as JSON.

public_api.name: call_triage_llm
public_api.role: Calls the Gemini LLM for one window with exponential backoff retry logic, raising TriageError if all retries fail.

public_api.name: triage_video
public_api.role: Process a single video by windowing its transcript, calling the LLM per window, and aggregating chunks into a list; returns (keep_decision, chunks) or None if no transcript exists.

public_api.name: run_stage3
public_api.role: Main orchestrator that processes all videos with transcripts, writes chunk sidecars, detects a dead endpoint if all triage calls fail, and updates the keep column in candidates.csv.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: Command-line entry point that parses arguments and invokes run_stage3().
